components.evidence: PDF Section 4 and Figure 1: Transformer blocks consist of equivariant merged layer normalization, equivariant graph attention, feedforward networks. SwiGLU-S2 is the activation function. eSCN convolutions are used. Embedding and Output Head are described in Appendix A.

backbone_architecture.evidence: PDF Section 4.1 and Section 3.2: EquiformerV3 adopts eSCN convolutions (Passaro & Zitnick, 2033) as the core equivariant convolution operation.

head_architecture.evidence: PDF Appendix A: Output Head uses feedforward networks with gate activation for graph-level predictions and equivariant graph attention for node-wise predictions.
